title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Cinematic product commercial with a motivated, fluid camera move and natural depth.
MODEL: No human or animal model. Use only the display arrangement supported by the reference; do not invent a hanger, mannequin, accessories or extra pieces.
SCENE: A quiet editorial studio with room around the full silhouette. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Begin low on the visible hem, then tilt upward to reveal the complete dress in one unbroken move. 2–6s Travel across the real fabric surface to show its visible weave, print or embellishment without exaggerating it. 6–8s Finish with the hem and neckline both unobstructed. 8–10s Finish with a full-product hero frame: hemline reveal, complete and unobstructed. Use a continuous, motivated camera move and let the product detail emerge naturally.
CAMERA: One smooth dolly or shallow arc; preserve perspective and garment proportions.
LIGHTING: Soft directional key light, gentle fill and natural shadows; retain source colours.
AUDIO: Restrained instrumental music below any selected voice; fabric rustle only when visibly caused. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Product-first commercial with thin white 2D doodles tracing only visible contours or construction details.
MODEL: One adult human model may wear the dress and make a restrained quarter-turn, or present it naturally if the reference shows it unworn. Preserve fit, cut, length, print and drape; add no jewellery, bags or shoes absent from the reference.
SCENE: Directional soft light with clean highlights and true-to-reference colour. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Open on the upper silhouette and actual neckline with a measured push-in, never a sudden zoom. 2–6s Arc slightly around the neckline and bodice to reveal visible stitching, print or trim. 6–8s Ease back to a composed full-dress frame. 8–10s Finish with a full-product hero frame: neckline study, complete and unobstructed. During the detail beat, add one thin white contour trace around a visible edge, seam or pattern; never cover the product or add words.
CAMERA: Slow stable push or lateral slide so the product remains readable.
LIGHTING: Clean even lighting with accurate garment colour and clear edges.
AUDIO: Light playful instrumental music at low volume; no spoken words by default. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

MODEL: One adult human model may wear the dress and make a restrained quarter-turn, or present it naturally if the reference shows it unworn. Preserve fit, cut, length, print and drape; add no jewellery, bags or shoes absent from the reference.
SCENE: Even, colour-accurate light; no invented motifs. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.

CAMERA: Slow push, short lateral slide or locked-off framing; no unnecessary flourish.
LIGHTING: Broad balanced soft light with delicate shadows and accurate colour.
AUDIO: Quiet unobtrusive instrumental music; no unnecessary sound effects. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 3-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Creative reveal through framing, focus, shadow or camera movement; the product never transforms.
MODEL: No human or animal model. Use only the display arrangement supported by the reference; do not invent a hanger, mannequin, accessories or extra pieces.
SCENE: Controlled studio light with detail in highlights and shadows. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Reveal the complete item and establish its position. 2–6s Start at the visible waistline and travel down the actual seam or panel toward the hem. Continue into a shallow low angle showing the real hem shape and layers, if present.  6–8s Ease into a stable transition frame. 8–10s Hold that exact position briefly for the next clip. Reveal the product through a clean foreground slide or focus change, never by morphing or fabricating objects.
CAMERA: Foreground-edge reveal, rack focus or controlled slide, then show the entire item clearly.
LIGHTING: Shape the reveal with realistic light and shadow while preserving original colour.
AUDIO: Subtle modern instrumental music; no magical transformation sounds. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 3-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Carefully composed flat-lay or elevated product study; retain the reference's display arrangement.
MODEL: One adult human model may wear the dress and make a restrained quarter-turn, or present it naturally if the reference shows it unworn. Preserve fit, cut, length, print and drape; add no jewellery, bags or shoes absent from the reference.
SCENE: Minimal set; no props implying unverified features. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–4s Partly frame the dress with a background edge or existing shadow, then slide clear to reveal it fully. 4–13s Push toward one genuine design detail without covering the garment. 13–23s Hold the dress centered with generous negative space. 23–30s Finish with a clean, steady hero frame: negative-space reveal. Keep the product's plane and arrangement fixed; create interest through overhead parallax and a careful detail pass.
CAMERA: Slow overhead drift or gentle angled slide; do not rotate the garment independently of the surface.
LIGHTING: Soft top light with tidy believable shadows and even detail.
AUDIO: Soft minimal instrumental music; no sound effects unless a visible action causes them. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Product-first commercial with thin white 2D doodles tracing only visible contours or construction details.
MODEL: Animals are not appropriate for ordinary human apparel. Do not add an animal or put this garment on one; only depict animal apparel if the reference itself clearly shows an animal garment.
SCENE: Minimal set; no props implying unverified features. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Reveal the complete item and establish its position. 2–6s Partly frame the dress with a background edge or existing shadow, then slide clear to reveal it fully. Push toward one genuine design detail without covering the garment; keep all lines thin, white and subordinate to the garment.  6–8s Ease into a stable transition frame. 8–10s Hold that exact position briefly for the next clip. During the detail beat, add one thin white contour trace around a visible edge, seam or pattern; never cover the product or add words.
CAMERA: Slow stable push or lateral slide so the product remains readable.
LIGHTING: Clean even lighting with accurate garment colour and clear edges.
AUDIO: Light playful instrumental music at low volume; no spoken words by default. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 2-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
